mission.title: Protection Racket
mission.description: Protect a recruitment team from imposter Agents.

npc.say: Extracting humans from the Matrix takes special training. We're a crack team, so no worries.
Thank you, {player}. We'll get them to Zion safely.

phase.briefing: Warrior, I'm sure that you already know of these imposter Agents with electronic light implants in their ears. Real Machine Agents value bluepills as power supplies, and don't harass them, but these imposters kill our redpill operatives and bluepills alike, and are causing a great deal of trouble for our brave recruitment teams. Your mission is to protect a recruitment team and their potential recruit from these false Agents--if we allow this harassment to continue, our recruitment efforts will bear no fruit and Zion itself will wither and die!

enter.say: One of our recruiters, Birch, and his potential recruit Jeanmarie Ferrol have been surrounded by false Agents in that building. {player}, I need you to defeat the imposters and then lead Birch and Jeanmarie Ferrol to a nearby extraction point. Do not let them fall at the hands of the imposter Agents!
Birch and Jeanmarie Ferrol have locked themselves in the far room to protect themselves from the marauders.

done.say: Good work, {player}. These imposter agents cannot withstand the might of Zion!

objective.text: Kill all of the imposter Agents

done.say: You've destroyed all the imposter Agents! {player}, you are a true warrior of Zion.

objective.text: Find the key to the locked room

done.say: Your careful search has paid off, Warrior! That key should open the door to the room in which Birch and Jeanmarie Ferrol have locked themselves.

talk.say: Thanks, operative! I couldn't fight all those Agents while still protecting Jeanmarie Ferrol, so I had to lock us in here. Let's get back to Zion now.
Wow, you're a real fighter from Zion. Please, take me with you! I want to learn how to fight Agents like you.

done.say: You've found them! Great job, Warrior. Now lead them safely out of the building and to the extraction point nearby.

objective.text: Lead Birch and Jeanmarie Ferrol out of the building
Do not let Birch or Jeanmarie Ferrol die

phase.briefing: Excellent work, Warrior. The extraction point is nearby--I'm uploading the location to you now.

enter.say: The extraction point is in that building. You've almost got our people back to Zion!

objective.text: Lead Birch and Jeanmarie Ferrol to the extraction team

done.say: Great work, operative! Your job is done here, leave it to the extraction team to get our recruiter and his new soldier to Zion.

objective.text: Do not let Birch or Jeanmarie Ferrol die

complete.say: I can't believe I'm finally going to see Zion!
Alrighty, thanks for bringing them in! We'll get them to Zion safe and sound.

mission.finish: {player}, I was worried that the enemy forces might be too strong, but I can see that I worried needlessly. The imposter agents are no match for your skills.
